stories.title: Djokovic Confirms China Open Return After 11-Year Absence

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Novak Djokovic is heading back to Beijing.

The 39-year-old confirms his return to the China Open (Sep 30) after 11 years away — seeking a top-10 comeback after his shocking US Open first-round exit.

Six titles there. Can he make it seven? #Tennis #Djokovic #ChinaOpen

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Djokovic hasn't played the China Open since 2015 — when he won his 6th title there.

Now ranked No. 12 after a stunning R1 US Open loss, he's back in Beijing on Sep 30 chasing a top-10 return.

Sinner & Zverev also in the field. Wide open. #Tennis #Djokovic #ATPTour

article.headline: Djokovic Returns to China Open After 11-Year Absence, Seeking Top-10 Comeback
